I checked the laws against current upstream main, not the PR copy.

What looks good:

- Off writes no coolant word on the 24R and 770MX.
- Mist and Air use the machine's own code. Unsupported requests give a warning that names the operation.
- The section end resets the coolant request. The next section uses Flood when it has no request.
- The tests live in the correct crates. No dependency, process, UI, fixture or golden file changed.
- No golden moved. There is no golden diff to check line by line.

## Coolant word for each setting (`assets/posts/tormach.cps`)

The app enum is `CoolantMode` (`crates/post/src/post/coolant.rs:26`): Off, Flood (default), Mist, Air, ThroughTool. Flood sends no `PARAM Coolant`. The other modes send `off`, `mist`, `air`, `through-tool` (`coolant.rs:65`, `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs:312`). The codes come from the `tool_station.coolants` list of the machine file.

| Setting | 770MX (Flood M8, Mist M7) | 24R (no coolant list) |
|---|---|---|
| no request (old projects) | `M8`, same path as before (`coolantCode()`) | no word, no warning, same as before |
| Flood | `M8` | no word, no warning |
| Off | no word, no warning | no word, no warning |
| Mist | `M7` | warning "no mist coolant code in operation <op>", no word |
| Air | warning "no air coolant code", no word | warning, no word |
| Through tool | warning "no through-tool coolant code", no word | warning, no word |

- The word is written in `startPreamble` (line 600-601), after `S.. M3` and before the first move. This is the same place as before.
- `endPreamble` writes `M9` when a word was written (line 617), before `M5`. `onClose` calls `endPreamble` before `M30`. A tool change is in the next `startPreamble`, so `M9` is written before `T.. M6`.
- A warning from `msg()` is a counted warning. `crates/app/src/posting.rs:726` blocks the post on any warning ("post blocked - N warning(s)"). Thus an unsupported request blocks the post and names the operation. There is no silent fallback to flood: `coolantFor` returns "" for an unsupported request (line 247).
- A probe section (0 rpm) writes no coolant word, as before.

## Default path

- An operation with no request sends no `PARAM Coolant`. `coolantAsk` stays `"flood"`, and `coolantFor("flood")` calls the old `coolantCode()` without a change (line 237). The blocks and their position are the same as before.
- The only change on the flood path is the text of the refusal on a machine with only non-flood entries (line 229). That case blocked before and blocks now.
- No golden file changed in the diff.

## State across sections

- `endPreamble` sets `coolantAsk = "flood"` (line 618). `onSection` calls `startPreamble` at once (line 653), so `onSectionEnd` always runs the reset. The stream writes the next `PARAM Coolant` after the previous `ENDSECTION`, so the reset does not delete the request of the next section.
- Off, then no request: `M8 ... M9` only for the second section. `tormach_coolant_ask_does_not_leak_into_the_next_section` pins this.
- Flood, then Off: `M8 ... M9` for the first section, no word for the second. This follows from the code. No test pins this order.
- Two sections with the same coolant: each section writes its word again and `M9` at its end. This is the old behaviour.

## Other posts and the field

- Only `tormach.cps` changes. `tormach-lathe.cps` and `tormach-plasma.cps` do not change.
- `PARAM Coolant` is an existing field (#112/#150). It is not new in the stream, so the Klartext post and other posts see no new record. The engine refusal in `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:204` now does not apply to this post, because it declares `coolantModes = true` (line 29).

## Tests

- `crates/post/tests/tormach_coolant.rs` (new, 4 tests): Off and default on the 24R; Off, Mist and default on the 770MX; no leak to the next section; Through tool refused by name with no `M8`. Air on the Tormach post is not pinned here.
- `crates/app/tests/coolant_air.rs`: the change re-pins the assertion to the new behaviour. It does not weaken it.
  - Old: `assert!(out.warnings.iter().any(|w| w.contains("operation Face1") && w.contains("coolantModes")), ...)` for Air on a Flood M8 + Air M7 machine.
  - New: Air on a Flood + Mist machine must warn `operation Face1` and `no air coolant code`. Air on a Flood M8 + Air M7 machine must give no warning, one `M7` line and no `M8` line. The existing check "a Flood request on an Air-only machine is refused" stays.

- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3446`.

The marker says "Not run - owed to the wave run before merge" and lists these app lanes: `conformance`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `control_comp`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `probe_no_coolant`, `probe_op`, `program_entry`, `program_units`, `tormach_end_units`, `tormach_machines`, `tormach_post`, `wear_comp`.
- The marker sets a condition on the merge: "Ready for the maintainer to merge after the owed heavy run is green." and "Merge still requires a green record that covers this head." Merge only after that record exists.

1. Add a test for Flood followed by Off, to pin that no `M8` goes into the Off section.
2. Add a positive Air test to `tormach_coolant.rs` (the app test covers it now).
